response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), s AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, execution_count * 1.0 / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_avg FROM s ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Executions with NULL ordersmark form a single group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together), and that group counts as one order reference in the average share (average over groups).
The total number of execution records is the count of all rows in orderexecutions, including those with a NULL reference.
Ties at the 10th place are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.
